script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Let executer be the acting enemy of arg.
Let excludedAbilityListBySmartLot be executer → get-excluded-ability-list-by-smart-lot.
Let ability be a weighted random move of executer other than excludedAbilityListBySmartLot.
Let ability2 be the id of the move labelled "bay_ex" on executer.
If ability is not ability2, then executer uses ability and stop.
Let list2 be [{abilityTag: "bay_ex"}, {abilityTag: "dispell", abilityOptions: {skipMessage: true, skipAttackMotion: true}}].
Executer uses ability2 with its cast time and then list2.
